backgroundAppearance.description: "dark" puts the footer on a dark surface and inverts its text and dividers, in light mode only.

images.description: An array of images displayed in the footer. Each item includes an image, optional link URL, and component.

logo.description: The logo displayed in the footer. Can be any valid React node such as an image, icon, or SVG.

logoUrl.description: If provided, clicking the logo will navigate to this URL.

navItems.description: The prominent links on the top row, next to the logo. They are headings, not body text, and get no dividers.

navLinks.description: The smaller links on the bottom row, drawn in one line with dividers between them.

tag.description: A small label displayed next to the title.

tagColor.description: The Tag's color. A tuple sets the label, background, and icon colors by hand.

title.description: The main title displayed in the footer.
